lean.statement: ∀ {U : ℝ → ℝ} {β a : ℝ} (v : ℝ≥0), Measurable U → Function.Odd U → (∀ y : ℝ, |U y| ≤ β * |y|) → a ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 → MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun y ↦ Real.exp (-a * U y)) (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 v) ∧ (∫ y, Real.exp (-a * U y) ∂ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 v) ≤ Real.exp (β ^ 2 * (v : ℝ) / 2)
approved_definition_context: ℝ has its usual Borel measurable structure. Measurable means Borel measurable.
Function.Odd U means that U(-y)=-U(y) for every input y.
ℝ≥0 is the type of nonnegative real numbers. Its displayed coercion into ℝ is its underlying real value.
ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal m v is the real Gaussian probability measure with mean m and variance v. Variance zero is allowed and gives the Dirac measure at m.
Set.Icc l r is the closed interval defined by l≤x and x≤r.

MeasureTheory.Integrable f μ means that f is almost-everywhere strongly measurable and its norm has finite integral. The displayed integral is the real Bochner integral with respect to the specified measure.
